title_zh: Oxygen-TryOn：适用于任意单品的时尚原生虚拟试衣基础模型
title_en: Oxygen-TryOn: Fashion-Native Foundation Model for Any-item Virtual Try-On
summary_zh: 我们推出了Oxygen-TryOn，一种统一的任意单品虚拟试穿基础模型。它不是简单改造通用图像编辑器，而是专为试衣打造，配备专门的数据引擎和针对试穿的训练方法。只需一张目标主体图像和一件或多件参考单品（无论是干净的产品图片还是穿着实拍），即可合成主体穿戴该单品的真实感图像，覆盖几乎所有时尚类别。相比以往只支持单一服装类别的模型，Oxygen-TryOn支持多样单品和场景，包括全身或半身、多参考、自由组合，多层面保持主体身份和商品外观。它将试穿任务重构为多参考、理解驱动的生成任务，通过规模化数据引擎采集和标注高质量数据，采用三阶段训练方案：持续预训练、监督微调和强化学习。强化学习结合内部试穿奖励模型与专有多任务模型，确保细节一致性和指令质量，支持同轮次姿态等编辑指令。公开和自研基准测试中，Oxygen-TryOn在单品和多品类虚拟试穿表现均超越主流专有及开源模型，达到最新一流水平。
summary_en: We present Oxygen-TryOn, a unified foundation model specialized for any-item virtual try-on. Unlike repurposing general image editors, it is fashion-native with a dedicated data engine and try-on-specific training. Given a subject image and one or multiple reference items (clean product shots or worn images), it generates photorealistic try-on images spanning nearly all fashion categories. Unlike prior models limited to single garment categories or studio setups, Oxygen-TryOn supports diverse items and scenarios including full/half body views, multiple references, and free multi-item composition, while preserving subject identity and item appearance. The approach reframes try-on as a multi-reference, understanding-driven generation task. It leverages a large-scale data engine for high-quality data and a three-stage training regimen: continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with a hybrid reward balancing try-on consistency and instruction quality. It also supports pose and editing commands simultaneously. Across public benchmarks and proprietary tests, Oxygen-TryOn achieves state-of-the-art realism and consistency on single-item try-on and leads on multi-item try-on, surpassing major proprietary and open-source systems.
why_it_matters_zh: Oxygen-TryOn展示了将虚拟试穿任务从简单图像编辑转变为理解驱动生成任务的可能性，极大提升了多样化单品和复杂场景下的试衣效果。其专门构建的数据引擎和混合强化学习奖励策略为时尚AI提供了新的训练范式，推动虚拟试衣技术向更普适、更真实方向发展。
why_it_matters_en: Oxygen-TryOn illustrates a paradigm shift by framing virtual try-on as a multi-reference, understanding-based generation problem rather than mere image editing, significantly improving try-on realism and versatility across diverse items and scenarios. Its dedicated data engine and hybrid reinforcement learning reward strategy offer a novel training framework, advancing fashion AI toward more universal and photorealistic virtual try-on solutions.

title_zh: 保持一致性！通过一致性约束增强大型视觉语言模型的鲁棒视觉推理能力
title_en: Be Consistent! Enhancing Robust Visual Reasoning in LVLMs with Consistency Constraints
summary_zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）虽具备强大的感知能力，但在视觉推理任务中仍存在弱点。现有基准测试多侧重符号数学、科学问题及简单视觉任务，难以评估复杂视觉推理与逻辑一致性。我们提出ConVBench基准测试，包含六类配对逻辑等价问题，涵盖动作与状态、复杂计数、空间推理、因果与意图理解、常识推理及时间感知。结合此测试，设计逻辑一致性和鲁棒准确度两项指标，共同评估答案的正确性与一致性。我们进一步研发ConVLM，采用基于集团相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习，融入一致性奖励，利用自动生成的逻辑等价问答对及准确率与一致性双重激励，推动模型回答保持一致。该框架可在有无严格答案监督条件下有效运行。
summary_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have strong perceptual abilities but remain vulnerable in visual reasoning tasks. Existing benchmarks focus primarily on symbolic math/science problems and simple vision tasks, limiting evaluation of complex visual reasoning and logical consistency. The authors introduce ConVBench, a complex vision-centric reasoning benchmark featuring paired logically equivalent questions across six categories: action/state, complex counting, spatial reasoning, causal/intent understanding, commonsense reasoning, and temporal perception. They define two metrics, logical consistency and robust accuracy, to jointly measure correctness and consistency. Additionally, they propose ConVLM, which enhances LVLM reasoning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)-based reinforcement learning utilizing a novel consistency reward. By leveraging automatically generated logically equivalent question-answer pairs and a dual reward design combining accuracy and consistency signals, the framework encourages agreement between paired responses and works effectively with or without strict answer supervision.
why_it_matters_zh: 视觉推理系统对复杂场景的准确理解和逻辑一致性至关重要。该研究通过设计包含逻辑等价问答对的复杂基准和创新的训练方法，提升了LVLM在真实应用中的鲁棒性和可靠性，为未来视觉推理技术的发展奠定了基础。
why_it_matters_en: Accurate understanding and logical consistency are critical for visual reasoning systems in complex scenarios. This work advances LVLM robustness and reliability through a novel benchmark with logically equivalent question pairs and a reinforcement learning method emphasizing consistency, laying groundwork for future progress in visual reasoning technologies.

title_zh: 稳健超声图像分割的风险引导隐式边界细化
title_en: Risk-Routed Implicit Boundary Refinement for Robust Ultrasound Image Segmentation
summary_zh: 医学超声图像分割面临散斑噪声、低对比边界、声影及不同操作员和临床中心采集差异等挑战。本文提出了一种紧凑的分割框架——风险引导隐式边界细化（RIBR），利用隐式神经表示作为风险引导的残差校正，而非无约束的全掩码预测器，结合边界细化隐式残差、风险引导残差控制及几何与散斑感知边界正则化，有效细化不确定轮廓并抑制非边界振荡。在包含淋巴结、乳腺病灶、甲状腺结节和前列腺的九个超声数据集上，RIBR表现出最佳宏观平均性能和稳定降低边界误差，且参数量紧凑，展现了该方法在资源受限和边界敏感的超声分割中的实用性。源代码已公开。
summary_en: Medical ultrasound image segmentation is challenged by speckle noise, low-contrast boundaries, acoustic shadowing, and variability across operators and clinics. This work introduces Risk-routed Implicit Boundary Refinement (RIBR), a compact segmentation framework that employs implicit neural representation as a risk-routed residual correction rather than an unconstrained full-mask predictor. Combining boundary-refinement implicit residuals, risk-routed residual control, and geometry- and speckle-aware boundary regularization, RIBR refines uncertain contours while suppressing non-boundary oscillations. Evaluation on nine ultrasound datasets covering lymph nodes, breast lesions, thyroid nodules, and prostate shows RIBR achieves the best overall macro-average and consistently reduces boundary error with a compact parameter budget, demonstrating practical utility for boundary-sensitive ultrasound segmentation. Source code is available.
why_it_matters_zh: RIBR通过风险引导的残差学习机制，有效解决了超声图像中边界模糊和振荡问题，同时保持模型紧凑，适合临床资源受限环境。
why_it_matters_en: RIBR leverages a risk-routed residual learning mechanism to effectively address ambiguous and oscillating boundaries in ultrasound images while maintaining a compact model, making it suitable for resource-constrained clinical settings.
